newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch May manufacturing output up 4.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch May manufacturing output up 4.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production rose 0.4 percent in May compared with April, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
May manufacturing production was 4.1 percent higher than in the same month of 1996, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION May 97 April 97 May 96
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
The CBS said almost the entire Dutch industry had seen high growth levels in May.
In the chemicals, rubber and plastics industries, output rose by nearly seven percent in the first five months of 1997 compared with those of 1996.
Output of wood and building materials rose 8.5 percent during the same period, but production was almost the same in May as a year ago, the CBS said.
Output growth in the the paper and graphics sector and in the food industry underperformed the overall industrial average in the first five months of the year, but picked up in May.
Economists' consensus forecast for May manufacturing production was a rise of 4.3 per cent year-on-year and a rise of 1.1 percent month-on-month.
